run_ADIDAS_solver: run the ADIDAS solver to approximate the limiting logit equilibrium of a normal-form game
estimate_exploitability_sym: estimate exploitability via monte carlo for symmetric games using the ADIDAS solver
estimate_exploitability_nonsym: estimate exploitability via monte carlo for nonsymmetric games using the ADIDAS solver
construct_payoff_matrices_from_samples_s: construct approximate symmetric payoff matrices from sampled game queries
construct_payoff_matrices_from_samples_n: construct approximate nonsymmetric payoff matrices from sampled game queries
